learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparing numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected zero missed intervals and locked it in for 100 pollsters using 95% intervals.
observations.exploration: First batch had seven misses out of 100. Pressed 100 new pollsters: six misses in second batch, retained total 13 of 200, 6.5%. Reveal unlocked after first batch.
observations.reveal: Corrected about five. Uses first seven and aggregate 13 of 200, then states exact miss chance 5.4% for these intervals. Explains coverage belongs to method over repetitions, not certainty about one interval; pollster cannot see true line.
observations.visual: Inline first-batch screenshot inspected: horizontal intervals across fixed vertical 50% line, seven red bars fail to cross. Axis 40-60%, batch and cumulative counters legible. Trust count 4/4 ignored.
observations.isolation: No-history evaluation preview banner present. Visible trust count ignored.
observations.reference: Own CUA tab 543884151 snapshots and inspected inline screenshot; no screenshot file saved.
